authority: PLAN_forex_v5.md sections 1, 2, 4; axis-2 funding decision delegated to P0b successor evidence; forbidden inventory research/control/forex_free_v4_run/forbidden_family_inventory.json binding on A5
mechanism_class: breakeven-driven (inflation-expectations component of the nominal/real decomposition)

mechanism.one_line: Vintaged US 10-year breakeven-inflation SHOCK continuation: a 5-business-day change in ALFRED-vintaged T10YIE is a persistent inflation-path information shock that spot FX under-reacts to for 1-3 sessions because the marginal FX pricer (systematic accounts on a weekly CFTC re-weight cycle, corporate hedgers on a monthly cycle) updates slower than the dealer-intermediated breakeven market; the anchor trades the next 3 sessions in the sign of the shock.

mechanism_before_parameter.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: TIPS/breakeven repricing originates with rates desks and dealer inventory in a thin, dealer-intermediated market; the FX side is repriced by systematic trend/CTA accounts that re-weight weekly (CFTC reporting cycle) and corporate/hedging flows that rebalance monthly. Neither is forced to react intraday to a breakeven move; the under-reaction window is 1-3 sessions.
mechanism_before_parameter.why_the_effect_exists: A 5-day breakeven change is a persistent information shock (it forecasts CPI-path revisions and Fed-relevant repricing), not microstructure noise; persistent shocks diffused into a market whose marginal participants update weekly produce same-sign drift, not instant random-walk pricing.
mechanism_before_parameter.observable: Same-sign FX drift over the 3 sessions following large 5-day breakeven moves, measurable per decision row with the vintaged as-of series; PIT-testable because each decision reads only rows whose ALFRED realtime_start vintage precedes it.
mechanism_before_parameter.when_it_must_fail: (1) When breakeven moves are liquidity/supply-technical (TIPS settlement, auction cycles, dealer balance-sheet) rather than information - the shock carries no inflation-path content and the book must degrade to noise. (2) When inflation is the market's dominant attention object (e.g. the 2021-22 regime) and repricing is same-session - the continuation window collapses; the frozen 3-fold structure will expose this as regime dependence and the fold gates must kill it. (3) If the effect is USD-index beta rather than inflation information, the runner-owned USD-drift diagnostic (|corr| > 0.30) fires.
mechanism_before_parameter.control_that_kills_the_convenient_explan: Causal control arm = vintage-shuffled placebo: every decision reads the T10YIE value from a seeded, frozen shuffled vintage mapping (deterministic permutation with seed 20260905, each decision t mapped into [t-180, t-1] days, table committed at freeze). It preserves the series' marginal dynamics while destroying the as-of information linkage: if the placebo reproduces the anchor, the behaviour is generic FX drift, not vintage information, and CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM kills the family. A second, unscored identifiability check at D2 (nominal-yield placebo: DGS10 5-day change, same clock and lag) kills the 'any US rates shock works' explanation.

signal_definition.series: ALFRED T10YIE (10-Year Breakeven Inflation Rate, daily; nominal DGS10 minus real DFII10 decomposition)
signal_definition.shock: d5(t) = T10YIE_vint(t) - T10YIE_vint(t - 5 business days), both reads strictly as-of decision time t
signal_definition.normalization: z5(t) = d5(t) / rolling stdev of d5 over the trailing 252 vintaged daily observations, all as-of t (no backfill)
signal_definition.decision_rule: z5(t) > 0 -> LONG the USD leg of every authorized pair; z5(t) < 0 -> SHORT the USD leg; z5(t) == 0 or no eligible vintage -> no decision (NO_EVAL, never backfilled). No activity thresholds, no sizing weights - sign-only, one mechanism.

universe_note: runner notation EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF, USD/CAD, AUD/USD, NZD/USD; USD appears as base or quote per market convention; the signal is common (US series) so pair_concentration (<=40%) and dropout (>=6/8) are the honest concentration police

data_source.provider: ALFRED (archival FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis), keyless graph-CSV or api.stlouisfed.org with an OWNER key
data_source.vintage_semantics: TRUE as-of per row: every series row must carry its ALFRED realtime_start vintage stamp; a decision at time t may read only rows with realtime_start <= t, mirroring the inherited PolicyRateReader as-of gating (missing eligible vintage -> None/NO_EVAL, never backfilled). The revision test - comparing the same observation_date across at least two distinct vintages - is the ONLY provable PIT check and is mandatory before S0: if T10YIE shows zero revisions across the S0 window, the PIT claim is unprovable and the cell is BLOCKED, not scored.
data_source.expected_coverage_check: vintage-complete daily coverage of the S0 window must be MEASURED by the successor P0b probe before any read is legal; asserted bounds are never authorized (P-1)

Any miss -> the proposal stays DATA_BLOCKED_VALID.

decision_clock.clock: daily 16:00 America/New_York completed bars (inherited DST-aware calendar; weekend gate: no fills Saturday/Sunday, market reopens Sunday 21:00 NY)

warmup.consequence: first decisions ~2019-05 given S0 start 2018-04-04; all three frozen folds expected populated; declared to the runner via meta.warmup_daily_bars for the a5_per_pair_day_normalized_v1 alpha window

features: 252-bar rolling stdev of the 5-day change (all as-of)
features_and_lags.lags: decision at t uses vintages strictly available before t; entry bar is the next completed session bar after the decision (one-event-lag); no same-bar fills (ONE_EVENT_LAG_VIOLATION fatal)
features_and_lags.forbidden_inputs: no policy-rate series, no CPI prints, no announcement-ledger conditioning, no price-derived features other than the entry/exit execution prices themselves

entry_exit_fills.entry: next completed 16:00-NY session bar after the decision (market order at that bar); one position per pair max - a pair with an open position skips (no pyramiding); Friday decisions fill Monday (3-day weekend lag is legal under the frozen validator)
entry_exit_fills.exit: entry bar + 3 sessions, market order at that bar's 16:00-NY close (fixed horizon, no stop/target parameters)
entry_exit_fills.force_flat: fold-boundary force-flat per the inherited runner; trades spanning the 2022-05-01 internal boundary are refused (FOLD_FORCE_FLAT_VIOLATION)

costs.frozen_schedule: cost = notional * (1.5 bps * tier) / 10000, charged ONCE per fill side, notional 10000 USD-units, tiers {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}; costs are never softened (blanket clause: no fee/cost assumptions below the frozen 1.5 bps x {1.0,1.5,2.0} authority)
costs.stress_booking: F1-fixed: booked PnL RE-COMPUTED at each tier's per-side cost on the SAME trades; tier rows pairwise distinct, kernel fails closed (STRESS_ROWS_NOT_DISTINCT); fill-delay stress carried unblended
costs.dual_books: price_only_pnl_usd and financing_adjusted_pnl_usd as separate immutable digest-covered columns; the price-only sign is never inverted; FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE gate live (adjusted-positive with price-only non-positive fails); financing adjustments carried by the family with the inherited frozen formula, never invented by the runner
costs.break_even_publication: break-even bps from the same cost kernel, 6-decimal convention, published per cell

arms.anchor: sign of the as-of 5-day T10YIE change (z>0 long USD, z<0 short USD), daily 16:00-NY clock, 3-session hold, as specified
arms.neighbour: same mechanism, 10-business-day change window (same series, same clock, same hold, same z-normalization over 252 bars); must SUPPORT the anchor or NEIGHBOUR_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_ANCHOR fails the family - this is a robustness neighbour, not a second mechanism
arms.causal_control: vintage-shuffled placebo: identical machinery, but each decision reads T10YIE from a seeded frozen shuffled vintage mapping (permutation over [t-180, t-1] days, seed 20260905, table committed at freeze); PIT information linkage destroyed, marginal dynamics preserved; the control RUNS TO COMPLETION under the same evidenced semantics and must FAIL - reproduction kills the family via CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM
arms.benchmark_treatment: inherited required benchmark arm per the runner contract (not a scored cell); alpha definition declared as a5_per_pair_day_normalized_v1 with warmup_daily_bars = 257

falsification_rule.frozen_stage_a_gates: any of EXPECTANCY_NONPOSITIVE, PF_BELOW_1.10, FEWER_THAN_2_POSITIVE_POPULATED_FOLDS, POPULATED_FOLD_PF_BELOW_0.80, MDD_ABOVE_FROZEN_CEILING, PAIR_CONCENTRATION_ABOVE_40PCT, POSITIVE_FOLD_SHARE_ABOVE_50PCT, STRESS_TIER_1.5_FAIL, STRESS_TIER_2.0_FAIL (primary), DROPOUT_SURVIVAL_BELOW_6_OF_8, USD_DRIFT_EXPLAINS_ANCHOR, DECISION_FLOOR_NOT_MET, INCREMENTAL_ALPHA_NOT_POSITIVE, FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE -> family falsified, scored negative recorded
falsification_rule.mechanism_sanity: neighbour must support the anchor; the vintage-shuffled control must fail - CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM or NEIGHBOUR_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_ANCHOR -> family falsified
falsification_rule.nominal_placebo_identifiability_d2: at D2 the pre-selection control-identifiability measurement runs the DGS10 5-day-change placebo (same clock, same lag, unscored diagnostic): >= 90% decision-sign agreement with the anchor -> the 'inflation-expectation-specific' claim is dead -> reject even if the anchor passes all gates
falsification_rule.revision_test: zero vintaged revisions across S0 -> PIT distinctness unprovable -> BLOCKED (never scored as a pass)
falsification_rule.ancestry_rho_bar: at D2, measured Spearman rho of the anchor decision vector vs BOTH V3 family2 anchor variants (as-scored and evidenced-corrected books) AND vs the V4 family1 commodity-bloc anchor must satisfy |rho| <= 0.20; above the bar the cell dies pre-selection with no appeal

expected_failure_interpretation.scored_negative: a first-class honest result: vintaged breakeven shocks carry no after-cost incremental information for daily-or-slower FX books under the frozen gates; NOT a sign-flip opportunity, NOT a threshold-neighbour rescue target (blanket clauses bind); recorded, not repaired
expected_failure_interpretation.stress_tier_kill: if base tier passes but tier 2.0 (primary) kills it, the class is thin-margin per P-2 and the kill is recorded with per-gate margins; a knife-edge pass, if it occurs, is recorded as knife-edge
expected_failure_interpretation.usd_drift_fire: the honest reading is USD-index beta, not inflation information - the convenient explanation is confirmed as the explanation and the family is rejected
expected_failure_interpretation.placebo_reproduction: the mechanism identity/sign is wrong (E.2 class): behaviour without mechanism; recorded as a shadow effect, never pursued as an inversion
expected_failure_interpretation.modal_ex_ante_outcome: given 3.0 bps base round-trip cost against a 3-session drift class and the dominant-attention regime inside S0, the modal ex-ante outcome is a scored negative or a stress-tier kill - a correct negative is a successful research run (P-6)

decorrelation_from_carry_ex_ante.carry_ancestor: V3 family2 FXFV3-A6-P1: realized-vol regime-gated POLICY-RATE-DIFFERENTIAL LEVEL carry (BIS WS_CBPOL); decision = static differential sign, essentially constant per pair for months; front door CLOSED at D2 of V4 by measured rho 0.997-1.000 vs both invalidated-ancestor variants
decorrelation_from_carry_ex_ante.this_mechanism: decision = sign of a 5-day CHANGE in TIPS-implied breakeven inflation - a different market segment (inflation-expectations component, not policy rates), a different statistic (short-window change, not level), and a sign that flips on a large fraction of sessions; the carry information set (WS_CBPOL) is not an input anywhere in the feature stack
decorrelation_from_carry_ex_ante.ex_ante_expectation: rho expected near zero by construction (high-frequency sign flips vs near-static sign); the claim is nonetheless EMPIRICAL, not rhetorical: the |rho| <= 0.20 bar vs both ancestor variants is a binding pre-selection kill-switch
decorrelation_from_carry_ex_ante.not_a_relabel_statement: this proposal is not the V3 anchor with a new label, not a threshold/window variant of any forbidden row, and not a sign inversion of any rejected family
